newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel shadows crude, more Russian.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel shadows crude, more Russian.

text.p: Straight-run fuel oil broadly tracked crude on Monday.
Low sulphur material was quiet with NWE buyers holding back, although some transatlantic interest was seen.
"Supply and demand looks evenly balanced and sellers are trying to keep in touch with crude," said one trader.

High sulphur material was showing steady premiums of around formula +$4 for E-4 amid improved supplies. "I've seen more offered today than in a long time," said one trader. M-100 straight run was assessed at two means +$3-4.
